entries.title: Fixed Twin Pitched Rotors and Coiled Tines Tedder
entries.description: One newly authored complete parked two-rotor hay-tedder-style exterior. A whole transverse drive beam and long central forward draw frame support two small forward-pitched rotor drums. Each drum carries six full short radial arms, an outer tine crosspin and two entire coiled-wire long-finger forms per arm: twenty-four individual one-turn coil-and-finger solids total. Two complete small wheels directly beneath the rotor regions and a finite front parking sole ground the assembly. Whole upright wheel brackets, a central gear-cover exterior, a short shielded input shaft and an empty two-lug hitch exterior complete the fixed display. Every visible coordinate is newly authored, no rake or other machine meshes imported. Not the existing single upright-axis seven-long-arm rake with uncoiled curved tine pairs: this has two compact pitched rotor groups, twelve short carriers, twenty-four coiled tine forms and transverse drive support. Generic stylized one-turn coils, blunt wires and static unhitched presentation only; no branded dimensions or component fit copied. One model zero scenes. No rotation, gear transmission, working tine deflection, full-rotation clearances, hay movement, tedding performance, towing fit, continuous collision-free motion, spring strength, fabrication, load, engineering or machine safety capability made or verified. Guarding, rigging, animation and interaction are not made.
